notes:
Beta 1.5.20 - pure-stdlib install (no __requirements__).

Removed every pip dependency and the __requirements__ declaration. The plugin now runs entirely on the Python stdlib, so install never blocks on a pip resolve or a wheel build (which was the root cause of recent freezes on cold launch).

Replaced: requests + tenacity → urllib with manual 1s/2s/4s retry, packaging.version → numeric tuple compare, cachetools.TTLCache → small in-house dict-with-TTL, requests_cache → dropped (10s TTL already enforced in process), atomicwrites → tmp+os.replace.
